title: AtmosData Pro station-grade weather feed (fictional vendor)
summary: Vendor weather-observation feed (endpoint https://api.atmosdata.example/v2/observations) registered for UC1 as a station-grade source of temperature and humidity (N3) for the production window. The contract AD-2021-114 covered 2022-01-01 to 2025-12-31 and has ended with no signed renewal; the API key was revoked on 2026-01-01. Per the register no approved purposes exist, so the feed cannot be used. Not called, per vendor-feed rules; schema, grain and data coverage are unknown from the sources read.
